name: Codependence
tagline: Two halves that cannot function apart — red above, cyan below.

facts.note: Flagged two-player in the game data itself, and described by its creators as 'Duelo Maestro but better'. Kapinapi and ViralDl verified it as a pair on 4 July 2020; Pukklez then verified it solo on 4 June 2023 after roughly 165,000 attempts, one hand on each icon, which is the completion the community actually talks about.

spotlight.sub: Two icons, two hands, unsymmetrical gameplay. Solo completions are the ones the community talks about.

voice.hook: A level designed for two people, beaten by one.
voice.why:
Codependence is a mind-bending anomaly in the Geometry Dash community. Created by TCTeam, it is an incredibly brutal Extreme Demon designed specifically for two players, yet the ultimate flex in the community is to beat it entirely solo.

Controlling two separate icons with two hands through unsymmetrical, intensely difficult gameplay requires an almost inhuman level of brain-splitting coordination. It is a psychological and mechanical puzzle as much as it is a level, standing entirely in a league of its own.
